svg.title: We make explicit the uniform implicit construction used in the stationary integrations. Split the finite coordinate set into retained coordinates ι and vertical coordinates τ, assign every coordinate a lattice site by l, and assume at most K coordinates have any given site. Arrays carry their maximum norm. Write f(x, v) for the real analytic cost, S(x, v) = Dvf(x, v) for its vertical gradient, and H(x, v) = D2 vf(x, v). The analytic scatter bounds established above say that its coordinate derivatives, through a purchased order N ≥3, are bounded by a constant C > 0 times the exponential connecting weights with width a > 0, on the maximum-norm ball of radius r > 0.
